purpose: Local scalar/vector/tensor directional encodings, scalar and tangential field spectra, and a kinematic scalar transport check
scope: Representation prototype; no real weather time model, no native Adva execution, no assimilation, no forecast publication
normalization: real spherical harmonics orthonormal under dOmega/(4*pi); scalar Y00=1; gradient and rotational vector bases divided by sqrt(l*(l+1))
coupling: Galerkin projection of df/dt=-u.dot(grad_S(f))/radius with prescribed stationary tangential u
coupling_example: solid rotation Omega=(0,0,1); f0=280+3*x+2*(x*x-y*y); dimensionless radius=1; evaluate t=pi/4
real_snapshot: ERA5 2020-01-01T00:00, previously downloaded 1.5 degree sample; exact poles excluded

real_fit.area_weights: cos(latitude), normalized globally; shared valid mask for wind components

real_fit_limit: In-sample representation residual only, not forecast skill; masked coefficients define a regularized extension, not observed land SST or subsurface atmosphere
fine_grid_fields: ssr/str/sd require a separately validated regridding and domain pipeline; excluded from this snapshot run
radiation: tisr sample remains in its source J/m2; this representation check does not infer accumulation duration
checks: local vector and symmetric tensor inverse
masked-value poison invariance and rank refusal
original even wind spectrum cannot identify transport speed
